prompt:
1. 깜깜한 우주. 별들 만이 빛나고 있는데. 거대한 행성 하나가 지구를 향해 돌진하고 있다. 카메라는 행성을 앞에서 보여주다가 옆으로 돌아서 행성이 지구로 돌진하는 장면을 보여준다.
2. 지상에서는 핵미사일 수백개가 하늘을 향해 발사 된다.
3. 행성은 핵미사일에 맞아 크기가 점점 줄어들어서 결국 작은 돌멩이가 되어 땅에 떨어진다.
4. 어떤 사람이 노상 카페에서 커피를 마시고 있는데, 잠깐 다른데 보는 사이에 땅에 떨어진 행성조각이 커피에 들어감.
5. 커피를 마시고 그 사람이 벌떡 일어선다.
6. 그리고 갑자기 하늘위로 직각으로 슈퍼맨 자세로 날아간다.

environment.overview: A contemporary, high-contrast grayscale world combines utilitarian concrete military architecture, modest stone-and-glass café architecture, rough celestial rock, pale atmospheric haze, and black star-filled space under hard directional sunlight.
environment.location_type: Connected exterior locations spanning space, an atmospheric flight corridor, a missile-launch plateau, and a sidewalk café.

zones.name: Space Approach
zones.description: Black vacuum scattered with sharp stars, Earth’s immense curved disk with pale clouds and darker continents, and unobstructed space along the incoming planet’s trajectory; no built structures

zones.name: Earthward Sky
zones.description: A continuous open-air corridor extending from Earth’s thin atmospheric rim down to the air above the café; blackness grades into pale sky with altitude, cloud layers stretch below the upper reaches, and stone rooflines border the lowest reaches

zones.name: Launch Plateau
zones.description: An expansive concrete launch field containing hundreds of recessed launch openings, open hatch slabs, low protective berms, narrow service roads, and squat control bunkers beneath an unobstructed sky

zones.name: Café Terrace
zones.description: Pale paving beside a stone café frontage, broad windows, a shallow fabric awning, small round tables, lightweight chairs, and a curb bordering the street; the open edge of the terrace has clear sky overhead

baseline.time_of_day: Daytime on the visible Earth locations
baseline.weather: clear and dry, with vacuum beyond the atmosphere
baseline.lighting: hard sunlight from upper left, crisp ground shadows, and visible stars against black space.

breakdown.logline: As a rogue planet hurtles toward Earth, hundreds of nuclear missiles reduce it to a pebble that drops unnoticed into a café patron’s coffee, turning an ordinary sip into a sudden, vertically launched superhero flight.

beats.summary: A vast approaching planet is revealed to be on a collision course with Earth
Hundreds of nuclear missiles launch in a coordinated defense
Nuclear impacts shrink the planet into a single falling pebble
The pebble enters a café patron’s coffee while the patron looks away
The patron drinks the coffee and abruptly springs upright
The patron shoots vertically into the sky in a rigid superhero flying pose

subjects.name: Rogue Planet
subjects.appearance: enormous, nearly spherical mass of medium-gray stone with charcoal fissures and a narrow pale mineral belt
signature_features: blunt rocky knobs distributed around its entire circumference give its silhouette a recognizable uneven outline from any angle.

subjects.name: Nuclear Missiles
subjects.appearance: long pale-gray cylindrical bodies, dark pointed noses, four short tail fins, and bright exhaust plumes
signature_features: extremely slender proportions and four-fin tail silhouettes remain recognizable from front, side, or rear.

subjects.name: Café Patron
subjects.appearance: tall, lanky build, rounded crown of dense short curls, medium-gray short-sleeved shirt, pale straight-leg trousers, and dark low shoes
signature_features: exceptionally long limbs and a round, puffed hair silhouette are recognizable from any angle.

subjects.name: Coffee Cup
subjects.appearance: pale, thick-walled cylindrical cup with a broad loop handle, filled with dark coffee
signature_features: unusually broad body with a heavy projecting rim, recognizable even when the handle is hidden.

spec.shot_name: Rogue Planet bearing down on Earth
spec.angle: equatorial height, finishing side-on to the planet’s travel
spec.camera_move: smooth orbital arc from ahead of the approaching planet to its side
spec.backdrop: Sharp stars against black space, with Earth’s cloud-covered curved disk occupying the right side of the composition.
spec.action: The immense, knobbled planet advances toward Earth. The lateral reveal places the planet and Earth on the same unmistakable collision line.
spec.emotion: Cosmic dread, with the threat becoming suddenly comprehensible.
spec.transition: Hard cut from the advancing planet to the defensive launch.

subject_states.subject: Rogue Planet

spec.atmosphere: Nuclear flashes briefly bleach the atmospheric rim and cloud tops nearly white.
